title: B2B Commerce Benchmark Report
role: Art direction, editorial design, data visualisation & landing page design
desc: I designed WizCommerce’s B2B benchmark report and landing page, turning dense industry research into clear layouts, charts and takeaways.
lead: I designed WizCommerce’s B2B benchmark report and landing page, turning dense industry research into clear layouts, charts and takeaways.
body: A 50-page report on B2B wholesale commerce, supported by a landing page for readers to download it.
detail: An orange-and-black visual system connects the report, charts and digital touchpoints.
captions: Chapter openers — data, trends and wholesaler insights
contribution: Set the art direction and editorial layout system for the report.
Designed charts, benchmark spreads and takeaway pages to make the findings easier to scan.
Extended the report’s visual language to its download landing page.

story.challenge: Make a research-heavy B2B commerce report easy to navigate, without losing the detail that makes it useful.
decisions: Use a consistent grid and strong typography so readers can find the benchmark, evidence and takeaway quickly.
Give charts and key figures room to breathe, using orange to draw attention to the important comparison.
Carry the same visual language into the landing page, connecting the report and its digital introduction.
story.result: A 50-page report design and an accompanying landing page, with one visual system across editorial layouts, data visualisation and digital promotion.

summary: I designed WizCommerce’s B2B benchmark report and landing page, turning dense industry research into clear layouts, charts and takeaways.
